title: A/R Collection: the Customer chip narrows to one customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customers X and Z both have past-due invoices.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Collection" in the left list.
  3. Click the Customer chip.
  4. Type the first letters of customer X.
  5. Pick customer X.
  6. Read the customer groups.
  7. Reload the page.
  8. Read the customer groups.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 6:

  • only customer X is listed.

Step 8:

  • still only customer X.

Why this matters: A collector works one account at a time.
